title: The Tang-end political transition
subtitle: A boundary event for the time slice
shortSummary: The political transition around 907 marks the exhibition's Sui–Tang boundary while reminding us that institutions and textual networks do not disappear in one year.
curatorialDescription: The exhibition uses 907 as a boundary rather than a civilisational rupture; figures, texts, institutions and places need their own continuities.
researchNote: Late-Tang politics, urban networks, monasteries and textual circulation must be modelled separately instead of being compressed into one event.
